primitive.relation: the Petersen graph in two named views kept on their own carriers: Cycle D1 pedges/pconn/padj/petersen (the literal ordered table of fifteen natural pairs, the natural relation, false outside 0..9 and on equal ends, the ordinal relation on 'I_10 and its SGraph) equal GTBase.petersen.petersen_edge_table, petersen_conn and petersen_ord_adj by conversion, and the graph agrees pointwise with petersen_ord with the identity isomorphism; Cycle U10 petersenV/padj/petersen (the exact cardinality-two subtype of {set 'I_5}, disjointness, its SGraph) are kneser52V and kneser52_adj by conversion, the graph agreeing pointwise with petersen_kneser and by the identity isomorphism. The four constructor proofs are related through the graphs they build (eq_diso), never by proof-field equality. The views are related by the explicit isomorphism petersen_ord_kneser_diso (the labelling table of grounding_D1, now public); isomorphism is not equality of carriers. U10's Pedge/psupp/Padj stay convertible.

ordinal-table-view.note: the literal ordered fifteen-pair table, the natural relation (false outside 0..9 and on equal ends), the ordinal relation and its SGraph; conversion for the table and relations, pointwise adjacency and the identity isomorphism for the graph

kneser-view.note: the exact cardinality-two subtype of {set 'I_5}, disjointness and its SGraph; conversion for the carrier and relation (Pedge/psupp/Padj stay convertible), pointwise adjacency and the identity isomorphism for the graph
